d:
Get ready to groove to the beats of the evergreen classic "O Dilwalo Matwalo" from the movie "Taqdeer". Sung by the legendary Rafi Sahab, this mesmerizing song will transport you to a world filled with love, passion, and unforgettable melodies.
Credits:-
Singers: Mohammed Rafi
Music :Laxmikant-Pyarelal
Cast: Bharat Bhushan, Farida Jalal
Director : A. Salam
